name: PAINTOR (Probabilistic Annotation INTegratOR)
model_likelihood: Multivariate-normal approximation linking association Z-scores, locus LD and causal configuration.
prior: Empirical Bayes causal probabilities governed by functional annotations through a logistic model.
inference_algorithm: Across-locus maximum likelihood with EM; concave M-step optimized by limited-memory BFGS; fixed plug-in non-centrality parameters.
estimand: Per-variant posterior causal probabilities for functional follow-up.
data_input: Association Z-scores; locus SNP correlation LD matrix from individual data or an appropriate reference panel; binary functional annotations.
tunable_settings: Functional annotation set; maximum causal-variant count (at most three in practice); non-centrality approximation cutoff (3.7 in the paper).
